payload.title: The Kensington Residence
payload.description: A thoughtfully composed home, where generous proportions meet natural light. Beautifully detailed interiors open onto welcoming spaces for everyday living and entertaining. This fictional listing is part of the AUREL Estate demonstration collection.
payload.description_sr: Pažljivo osmišljen prostor sa obiljem prirodnog svetla. Prostrane sobe i kvalitetni detalji stvaraju prijatan ambijent za život. Ovaj izmišljeni oglas pripada demonstracionoj kolekciji AUREL Estate.
